mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph network to the supplied body was most worthwhile: the planned comparison links ongoing filtration and lymph return to fluid balance, rather than treating circulation as a static loop.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting route and then the venous junction felt somewhat repetitive, although each added a distinct part of the path.

surprise.text: The lymphatic entry flaps carrying proteins as well as fluid clarified what enters the drainage route; the inadequate-return view then showed why that route matters.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: the item titles and planned pictures made the connections reasonably clear. The term “muscle spindles” appeared without an explanation of what they sense.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting previously built systems and comparing fluid balance gave the constructions a clear physiological purpose.
